about: Interactive pages (exemplars and animations) shown in the 'Exemplars & animations' tab of a subtopic. Each series is a folder of self-contained HTML pages; 'topics' lists the subtopics a page appears under, the first being its home. Edit the pages here: site/labs/ is generated by tools/build_site.js.

series.title: Vertical Throw Practice
series.summary: Mental-calculation practice for a ball thrown straight up, building from velocity at an instant to the time of flight from a tower, then to a projectile as two vertical-and-horizontal motions.

pages.goal: Find the velocity at any instant by mental calculation.
Calculate the time of ascent in your head.
Calculate the displacement in your head from the velocities at the start and end of a time interval.
Calculate the maximum height reached, in your head.
What does the area under a v–t graph represent?
Find the time of flight of an object thrown up from a height.
See 2D projectile motion as two independent 1D motions.
